props.title: Paluck Technologies IPO
props.sub: SME · opens 28 Aug–1 Sep · public-source launch brief

items.v: Works across automobile services, logistics and equipment rental, and telecom engineering services.
Fuel, spares, consumables and fleet upkeep are paid before some government and contractor collections.
The published objectives include working capital, capex, general purposes and loan prepayment.
₹1.44L / stated lot at the upper price, before any broker-specific SME multiple.
Stated size: ₹33 Cr. Re-check the exchange notice for final terms.

props.title: What to verify before a bid
items: Fresh issue versus OFS: who receives the money?
Objects of the issue: debt, working capital, capex or general purposes?
Three-year revenue, profit and operating-cash-flow trend
Top customers, raw-material exposure and disclosed risk factors
Final price, lot, subscription and listing dates on NSE or BSE

props.title: Know the market you are entering

items.v: This is an SME issue. Confirm the application multiple and liquidity conditions with the exchange and your broker.
The final RHP and NSE or BSE IPO page are the source for terms and live subscription.
Grey-market premium is unofficial, volatile and not a listing prediction.
Match the filing evidence to your risk tolerance; this video does not say apply or avoid.
